name: Beaded Tiara and Gloves

images.alt: Beaded Tiara and Gloves – handmade girls outfit, made to order in Pakistan

description: A bright princess accessory set of beaded tiara and a pair of matching gloves. The tiara is designed with flexible wire woven into pretty branches filled with smooth beads, while the soft sheer gloves fit comfortably on arms for a royal touch.
description2: It is lightweight and sits comfortably on the head to make your little girl feel like royalty. This crown can be customized in any color combination to match her special party dress.e, sparkly look.
